Indian standard ( Reaffirmed 2003 ) 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
CUTTER SUCTION DREDGE COMPONENTS 

PART 4 SPUDS 



1. Scope — Prescribes design and material requirements for spuds used on cutter suction dredgers. 

2. Requirements 

2.1 Design — The size and strength of a spud shall be determined by the following : 

i) Displacement of the dredge 
11) Digging depth 
iii) Cuttar power 

2-1.1 The maximum moment acting on the spud shall be determined at the point where it enters the 
bottom of the cut. 

2.2 Material — Mild steel or built up plate with tensile strength not less than 400 N/mm^ conforming 
to IS : 226-1975 ' Structural steel (standard quality ) ( fifth revision ) '. 



EXPL A N A TOR Y NOT£ 

The dredge is held in position or moved about with spuds. They are located at the stern of the 
dredge opposite each other and are supported either by a structure called a gantry or by a free 
standing hydraulic cylinder. 



Adopted 31 March 1984 



O June 1984. ISI
